answer: A sybil ring operating from one island of shared infrastructure gets flagged when its sable key fingerprints cluster, and the stake is slashed. Each agent must stake a unique basalt token minted once per verified hardware root, so cloning identities requires buying fresh physical devices. Attacker cost scales linearly with every fake reputation slot, making mass forgery economically irrational. In practice, qwe0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
